next_step.title: Extract Cañada's 26 moved pages, then the harvest's other colleges and the Commons step 2
next_step.text: The reader now reads Cañada's three heading shapes and the capture-only run moved 26 programs' pages, eight of the eleven empty records onto their own headings: dispatch the extraction (step read, extract 1, about two dollars under Sam's standing go), then reread, load and the display build on main. Then Merced's 18 unfound, Taft's 21 and San Joaquin Delta's 50 records failing a machine check, and the Commons step 2, each common reference's Progress view drawn from the shared module with its definition of complete on a card for Sam. The nightly cer-procedures run of 07:47Z is the first saving night with no one watching; read its receipt and the morning fold.

notes.addenda: The eight addenda amending loaded colleges' catalogs were read on Oct 14 and filed on Oct 14 as read, each with the programs and courses it changes. The other 71 listed addenda wait for the reader to reach their colleges.
